# Astros Kulture — Streetwear Brand
> Premium Heavyweight 240 GSM Cotton Streetwear, Oversized Drop-Shoulder Tees & Custom Apparel Pan-India.

## About
Astros Kulture is an Indian streetwear apparel brand specializing in 240 GSM combed cotton drop-shoulder oversized t-shirts, anime graphic collections, and interactive custom t-shirt design prints.

## Core Links
- [Astros Kulture Storefront](https://astroskulture.in/): Official homepage and new streetwear drops.
- [All Products & Streetwear Catalog](https://astroskulture.in/shop): Complete catalog of oversized graphic tees.
- [Apparel Categories](https://astroskulture.in/categories): Explore anime, space, minimalism, and oversized collections.
- [Custom T-Shirt Design Studio](https://astroskulture.in/custom-design): Interactive front and back t-shirt customization.
- [Official Blog & Streetwear Journal](https://astroskulture.in/blog): Fashion guides, sizing advice, and streetwear trends.
- [Privacy Policy](https://astroskulture.in/privacy-policy): Customer data protection and privacy policies.
- [Terms of Service](https://astroskulture.in/terms-of-service): E-commerce store terms and conditions.
- [Shipping Policy](https://astroskulture.in/shipping-policy): Domestic shipping timelines and free delivery thresholds.
- [Return and Refund Policy](https://astroskulture.in/return-refund-policy): 7-day hassle-free return and replacement policy.

## Feeds & Machine-Readable APIs
- [Google Merchant Center XML Feed](https://astroskulture.in/feeds/google-merchant.xml): Standard RSS 2.0 product feed for search crawlers.
- [Meta Catalog CSV Feed](https://astroskulture.in/feeds/meta-catalog.csv): Product catalog feed for Instagram/Facebook shops.
- [XML Sitemap](https://astroskulture.in/sitemap.xml): Dynamic index of all live product and blog URLs.
